root-canal-treatment.price_factors:
The first thing that sets the price of a root canal is how many roots and canals the tooth has; the more canals, the more work. The second is difficulty. Canals that run very close to the sinus in the upper jaw, or to the nerve in the lower jaw, count as risky, difficult canals, and that is exactly the examination finding that changes the quote. We can only see it on an X-ray.

So we do not give a firm figure without seeing the tooth. In the end, the biggest factor is the experience of the clinic and the dentist. Without a proper examination with photos, an X-ray and, where needed, a 3D scan, none of this turns into a real quote.
root-canal-treatment.program:
Root canal treatment starts on the day you arrive in Istanbul, with an examination and an X-ray. Without pain the process can be shorter. If there is pain or infection it takes longer: the tooth is first dressed with a medicated root canal dressing, and only after the pain has settled is the tooth closed. There has to be a pause between the two stages; in total it can take 1 to 1.5 weeks.

For this reason we suggest planning a few days in Istanbul for a root canal. In the days in between we simply wait for the pain to ease. Root canal treatment does not usually require a second trip; the exact duration and plan, however, are confirmed after the X-ray and examination. We carry out only the treatment that is needed.

zirconia-crowns.price_factors:
With zirconia crowns, the price depends mostly on the material and how the crown is made. Monolithic zirconia is the more affordable and faster option. Layered crowns, with porcelain or e.max hand-layered on a zirconia core, cost more, because the ceramist builds them by hand and more technician sessions are needed. The number of teeth to be crowned also matters.

E.max is the most aesthetic option, but we cannot do it for everyone; every mouth is different, and which material suits you is decided after a detailed evaluation. In the end, the biggest factor is the experience of the clinic and the dentist. Without a proper examination with photos, an X-ray and, where needed, a 3D scan, none of this turns into a real quote.
zirconia-crowns.program:
For crowns we start the day you arrive in Istanbul with examination, X-ray and 3D scan; if the findings allow, the teeth are prepared the same day, with temporary teeth where needed. With monolithic zirconia the treatment is finished within 5 to 7 days at the latest; while the crowns are made you stay in Istanbul, then return for the fitting.

We regard e.max as the strongest option aesthetically, but not for everyone; every mouth is different and needs a detailed evaluation. Its schedule is therefore set only after the examination. Monolithic zirconia crowns fit into a single trip; a second trip only comes up if implants are part of the plan and need to heal. The exact plan is confirmed after photos, X-ray and 3D scan.
zirconia-crowns.refusals:
With zirconia crowns, the requests we decline are those that would mean cutting down healthy teeth only for cosmetic uniformity or an artificial look. We do not like making over-white, identical teeth that do not suit the face. Work that does not look natural, and that is not left to the dentist's judgment, has a high chance of causing serious problems later; healthy enamel that is cut away does not grow back.

Where a tooth can be saved, we suggest keeping the natural tooth first; a crown comes into question only when it is truly needed. Our dentists are very experienced and, in practice, handle the great majority of cases. Our refusals are about unnatural, risky requests, not about difficulty.

porcelain-veneers.price_factors:
With porcelain veneers, the main price driver is the choice of material. E.max veneers are the most aesthetic option, but we cannot do them for everyone; every mouth is different, and whether e.max suits you is decided after a detailed evaluation. Monolithic zirconia is the more affordable and faster option; hand-layered work costs more because it goes back and forth to the technician more often. The number of teeth also sets the quote directly.

So we do not give a firm figure without seeing your mouth. In the end, the biggest factor is the experience of the clinic and the dentist. Without a proper examination with photos, an X-ray and, where needed, a 3D scan, none of this turns into a real quote.
porcelain-veneers.program:
With porcelain veneers we start on the day you arrive in Istanbul: examination, photos, X-ray and 3D scan, to assess your mouth in detail. We regard e.max veneers as the strongest option aesthetically, but not for everyone; every mouth is different. The number of days and the schedule for e.max can only be given after this evaluation; we promise nothing in advance.

If e.max is not suitable, we discuss alternatives such as composite veneers, which are finished within a week at the latest, often the same day. While the veneers are being made you stay in Istanbul. A second trip usually only comes up if implants are also part of the plan. The exact plan is confirmed after the examination; we touch only the teeth that need it.
porcelain-veneers.refusals:
With porcelain veneers, the requests we decline concern unnatural shapes and colours: over-white, uniform teeth that do not suit the face. We also do not place veneers that would mean sacrificing healthy enamel only for a look; enamel that is removed does not grow back. Work that does not look natural, and that is not left to the dentist's judgment, has a high chance of causing serious problems later.

In such cases we discuss less invasive options at the examination; what fits is decided by the dentist after she has seen the teeth. Our dentists are very experienced and, in practice, handle the great majority of cases. Our refusals are about unnatural, risky requests, not about difficulty.

hollywood-smile.price_factors:
A Hollywood smile is not a single treatment but a plan, and the price follows what goes into that plan. The first factor is the material: e.max is the most aesthetic option, but we cannot do it for everyone, because every mouth is different. Monolithic zirconia is the more affordable and faster option; hand-layered crowns cost more because they need more technician sessions. The second factor is how many teeth are involved. The third is whether implants or crowns are part of the plan.

So we evaluate first in detail and talk afterwards. In the end, the biggest factor is the experience of the clinic and the dentist. Without a proper examination with photos, an X-ray and, where needed, a 3D scan, none of this turns into a real quote.
hollywood-smile.program:
A Hollywood smile is not one procedure but a plan combining crowns, veneers and, where needed, implants. On arrival in Istanbul: examination, photos, X-ray and 3D scan; if the findings allow, temporary teeth are made the same day. With monolithic zirconia the crown and veneer part is finished within 5 to 7 days at the latest; for e.max, every mouth is different, so that schedule is set only after a detailed evaluation.

Implants change the picture: when the bone permits, temporary loading is possible the same day, but the implants usually heal for 3 months (3 to 4 depending on brand) and you return for the final teeth. This does not fit into one trip. The exact plan is confirmed after the examination; we recommend only what is needed.
hollywood-smile.refusals:
The cases we decline are mostly requests for unrealistic, artificial-looking “Hollywood” teeth: over-white, all identical, not suited to the face. We do not like doing this kind of work. Results that do not look natural, and that are not left to the dentist's judgment, have a high chance of causing serious problems later. We have the same reservation when a patient wants to dictate the outcome against the dentist's opinion.

Instead, we suggest a natural design planned for the face. Our dentists are very experienced and, in practice, handle the great majority of cases. Our refusals are about unnatural, risky requests, not about difficulty.

dental-implants.price_factors:
With implants, the first finding that changes the quote is the bone. If a bone graft is needed, that is a separate factor that raises the price. The second point is timing: immediate loading depends on the bone type. If the bone is very soft, the implants usually have to be left to heal for 3-4 months, depending on the implant brand; when the bone is poor, we usually wait 3 months. Otherwise we make the teeth the same day using 3D scanning. All of this is decided on the X-ray and the scan.

In the end, the biggest factor is the experience of the clinic and the dentist. Without a proper examination with photos, an X-ray and a 3D scan, none of this turns into a real quote.
dental-implants.program:
When you arrive in Istanbul we start without delay. First we examine you and take an X-ray and a 3D scan; if the findings allow, the implants are placed the same day, and if the bone permits, temporary teeth are fitted at once (immediate loading). This depends on the X-ray and bone quality; we cannot promise it in advance.

If the bone is soft, we leave the implants to heal, usually for 3 months, 3 to 4 depending on the implant brand. You spend that time at home and return for the final teeth; this is the case that does not fit into a single trip. The exact plan is confirmed after we assess your photos, X-ray and 3D scan; we recommend only what you need.
dental-implants.refusals:
With implants we rarely decline outright; more often we say we need to look first. With severe bone resorption, we cannot tell whether an implant is possible without an examination and imaging (X-ray and, where needed, a 3D scan); it has to be looked at. We do not promise implants before seeing the bone; the dentist decides what can be done after reviewing the images, and the plan may change at that stage.

Our reservation about work that does not look natural and bypasses the dentist's judgment applies here too. Our dentists are very experienced and, in practice, handle the great majority of cases. Our reservations are about promising without seeing and about risky requests, not about difficulty.

all-on-4-implants.price_factors:
With All-on-4, the price logic is the same as for single implants. The first finding is the bone: a bone graft, if needed, raises the price. Immediate loading also depends on the bone type; with very soft bone the implants usually heal for 3-4 months depending on the brand, and with poor bone we usually wait 3 months. Otherwise we make the teeth the same day with 3D scanning. The material of the bridge also matters: monolithic zirconia is more affordable and faster, hand-layered work costs more because it needs more technician sessions.

In the end, the biggest factor is the experience of the clinic and the dentist. Without a proper examination with photos, an X-ray and a 3D scan, none of this turns into a real quote.
all-on-4-implants.program:
With All-on-4 we also start the day you arrive in Istanbul: examination, X-ray and 3D scan, then the implants if the findings allow. If the bone permits, a temporary fixed bridge is fitted the same day (immediate loading). We cannot promise this in advance; it depends on the X-ray and bone quality.

If the bone is soft, we leave the implants to heal, usually 3 months, 3 to 4 depending on the implant brand. You spend that time at home and return for the final bridge once healing is complete. With All-on-4 this is the case that does not fit into a single trip. The exact plan is confirmed after we assess your photos, X-ray and 3D scan; diagnosis first, then only the treatment you need.
all-on-4-implants.refusals:
With All-on-4 too, nothing is decided before we look at the bone. With severe bone resorption, we cannot tell whether this method is suitable without an examination and imaging (X-ray and, where needed, a 3D scan); it has to be looked at. We do not promise this treatment before seeing the bone; the dentist decides what can be done after reviewing the images, and the plan may change at that stage.

Our reservation about work that does not look natural, does not suit the face and bypasses the dentist's judgment applies here too. Our dentists are very experienced and in practice handle most cases. Our reservations are about promising without seeing and about risky requests, not about difficulty.

composite-veneers.program:
Composite veneers are a treatment that fits into a single trip. On the day you arrive in Istanbul we start with an examination and photos; if the findings allow, the veneers are finished the same day. Often we do not keep you waiting even a week; at the latest they are completed within a week.

Even when they are finished the same day, a follow-up check may still be needed. It is therefore wise to leave a few days before your return date for that check. How many days you need, and the exact plan, is confirmed once we have assessed your photos and the examination findings. Composite veneers do not usually involve anything that would require a second trip; we treat only the teeth that really need it.
composite-veneers.refusals:
With composite veneers we decline in two situations: when the requested look is unrealistic — over-white, uniform teeth that do not suit the face — and when composite is not the right material for the case. The second we cannot tell without an examination; that decision rests with the dentist. Work that does not look natural, and that is not left to the dentist's judgment, has a high chance of causing serious problems later.

In such cases we suggest what fits you; sometimes that is a different material, sometimes less intervention. Our dentists are very experienced and, in practice, handle the great majority of cases. Our refusals are about unnatural, risky requests, not about difficulty.
